_meta.title: Tier 2 regulator-sourced restriction triggers
_meta.purpose: Attribute- and ingredient-level triggers that make an otherwise-listable product GATED or PROHIBITED. Sourced from regulators (Ofcom, FDA, FCC, CPSC, UK/EU cosmetics regulation) and Amazon compliance references. Feeds the app's restricted-products checker as the ATTRIBUTE layer, on top of the TYPE layer (Tier 1) and the user's own violation notices (Tier 3).
_meta.confidence_note: Thresholds are from published regulator/industry sources and are accurate as of compile date but MUST be treated as 'verify before relying' — Amazon and regulators update. The definitive per-ASIN answer is always Seller Central 'Apply to Sell'. NEVER present as legal advice.
_meta.usage_rule: These triggers are a SOURCING ALARM (buy / don't buy / get docs first) and a listing-time WARNING. They are NOT a copy-editing instruction. NEVER remove a true disqualifying spec to list a prohibited product — that is concealment (account-ending). If PROHIBITED: block normal submit, allow logged force-list only. If GATED: warn + surface required docs, submit allowed.

triggers.label: FPV / video transmitter (VTX) power above unlicensed limit
triggers.trigger_logic: VTX EIRP above the unlicensed ceiling for the marketplace's country.

UK.threshold: 5.8GHz > 25mW EIRP (also 2.4GHz control > 100mW). Anything above 25mW on 5.8GHz is unlicensed-illegal.
UK.path: No practical retail path — licences are event/time/location specific. Treat as prohibited for resale.

US.threshold: 5.8GHz up to 1W (1000mW) EIRP licence-free under FCC Part 15. Above 1W needs HAM licence.
US.path: Legal if <= 1W. Same physical product that is prohibited in UK can be legal in US.

triggers.note: This is the clearest MARKETPLACE-SPECIFIC case: a 600mW VTX is PROHIBITED in UK but LEGAL in US. The checker must give different answers per marketplace.

triggers.label: Contains or ships with lithium-ion / lithium-metal battery
triggers.trigger_logic: Any product containing OR packed with a lithium cell. 'If it plugs in or charges, it's affected.'

UK.threshold: All lithium products need safety + transport docs. FBA generally prohibits > 100Wh without special approval. Wh rating must be consistent across marketplaces.

US.threshold: Same — UN38.3 test summary mandatory; CPSC safety standards apply. FBA > 100Wh restricted.

docs_if_gated: UN38.3 test summary (mandatory — Amazon rejects lithium listings without it)
SDS / MSDS with Wh rating stated
triggers.note: Amazon tightened this in 2026 — UL2054+UL1642+IEC62133+UN38.3 now expected for EVERY lithium ASIN. Watt-hour rating MUST match across regional listings or it's flagged. Scope is huge: not just power banks — toothbrushes, speakers, toy cars, tools.

triggers.label: Nebulizer / inhaler / medication-delivery or therapeutic device
triggers.trigger_logic: Product is or is presented as an FDA/MHRA-regulated medical device.

US.threshold: ALL nebulizers are FDA Class II, require 510(k), are prescription-only, and on Amazon are limited to sellers enrolled in the PROFESSIONAL HEALTHCARE PROGRAM (needs Amazon Business account). For most third-party sellers this is effectively closed.

UK.threshold: Class II medical device — requires UKCA/CE mark + Declaration of Conformity under UK MDR.

docs_if_gated: US: FDA device establishment registration / owner-operator number
US: manufacturer invoice (English) confirming purchase from manufacturer
US: packaging photos (all sides) + instructions for use
US: enrolment in Amazon Professional Healthcare Program
UK/EU: signed Declaration of Conformity listing standards met
triggers.note: Worse than ordinary 'gated' — the healthcare-program requirement makes this close to closed for most resellers. Also: Amazon's system OVER-triggers medical-device classification from KEYWORDS — beauty products, back straps, snore guards, baby items get flagged. So medical-sounding copy can flip a non-medical product into this bucket. Ties directly to the claims screener.

triggers.label: Goggles / eyeshields that block all light
triggers.trigger_logic: Eyewear that is NOT see-through / blocks all light from the user.

US.threshold: FDA requires eyewear to be see-through. Opaque goggles/eyeshields prohibited from sale and listing.

UK.threshold: Confirm UK-specific stance in Seller Central; likely similar restriction.

triggers.note: ATTRIBUTE-triggered prohibition — same shape as the FPV case. See-through eyewear is fine; the 'blocks all light' attribute is what prohibits it. A normal pair of goggles is sellable.

triggers.label: Cosmetic / skincare / topical — prohibited ingredient or requires safety docs
triggers.trigger_logic: Product applied to skin (topical) OR contains a prohibited/restricted cosmetic ingredient.

US.threshold: Topicals require approval. Prohibited ingredients: mercury, hydroquinone, bithionol, chloroform, certain skin-lightening actives. Check LegitScript / FDA prohibited list. Corrective/colored contact lenses prohibited.

UK.threshold: All cosmetics need CPSR + SCPN notification + INCI labelling + Responsible Person. Prohibited/restricted ingredients per UK Cosmetics Regulation 2020 Annexes II–VI.

docs_if_gated: UK/EU: CPSR (Cosmetic Product Safety Report, signed by qualified assessor)
US: FDA registration, GMP certificate, COA, manufacturer invoice (last 180 days)
triggers.note: Facial steamer + essential-oil diffuser edges into topical/cosmetic territory. CLAIMS TRAP: anti-acne / anti-aging-treatment / disease claims flip a cosmetic into an OTC DRUG = instant restriction. Ties to claims screener.

triggers.label: Wireless / radio-transmitting device (general)
triggers.trigger_logic: Radio-transmitting device — needs type approval and must respect power/frequency limits.

UK.threshold: Must comply with Ofcom IR2030 band/power limits + UKCA marking. Signal JAMMERS are outright prohibited. Surveillance/hidden-camera devices restricted.

US.threshold: FCC certification required (FCC ID). Jammers prohibited by FCC. Surveillance devices restricted.

triggers.note: Jammers = always prohibited both marketplaces. Frequency/power over the unlicensed limit = the FPV pattern applies to any RF device, not just drones.

cross_cutting_notes.marketplace_specificity: Several triggers give DIFFERENT answers per marketplace (FPV: UK-prohibited / US-legal). The checker MUST resolve status per marketplace, never globally.
cross_cutting_notes.claims_interaction: Medical-device and cosmetic-to-drug classifications are often triggered by COPY KEYWORDS, not just the product. The claims screener and this restricted-type checker overlap here — a medical/therapeutic/treatment claim can pull an ordinary product into a restricted bucket.
cross_cutting_notes.no_match_not_safe: Absence from this list is NOT a clearance. Only Seller Central 'Apply to Sell' per ASIN is definitive.
cross_cutting_notes.concealment_prohibition: This data is a sourcing alarm. NEVER use it to strip a true disqualifying spec from copy to list a prohibited product. That is concealment and risks account termination (per the user's own Shee'lady Section 3 history).
